r3_considered.decision: R3 NOT added; R4 stays expected (three incidents).
r3_considered.definition_applied: rules.py R3: 'No mentions of police, jail, arrest, legal action, or physical threats like "we will come to your house"'. The analysis prompt adds 'threats, intimidation or coercive conduct'.
lines_examined: Aapke bhai defaulter hain. Aap unko samjhao, warna sabko pata chal jayega ki woh paise dabaa ke baithe hain.
Aap family hain, aapki bhi zimmedari hai. Unke office mein bhi hum bata denge.
r3_considered.finding: Turns 5 and 7 threaten to tell others about the debt ('warna sabko pata chal jayega', 'Unke office mein bhi hum bata denge'). That is the disclosure the R4 rule already covers. The script contains no police, jail, arrest, legal action or physical threat, and no separate coercive act apart from the disclosure itself, so no R3 is independently satisfied.
r3_considered.policy_preserved: R3 and R4 are both counted when both genuinely apply independently; that is not the case in this script.
